tracks.name: BA1
tracks.description: KNPA, 25L, finger four formation on take-off. 90% throttle on take-off and climb out (shallow climb), to exactly 300 knots. #4 should go to diamond position immediately after take-off. Then half cuban eight (half looping + rollout) at 3G max, reducing throttle when speed starts to increase. Down to 300 feet at 380 knots. Then break (#1 up 35-40 degrees, #2 break right, #3 break left, #4 goes straight), dropping speed to 350 knots (#2/3/4, use speedbrake shortly). Keep flying straight for 12 seconds after the start of the split (10 seconds after the turn),  turn in and pull at around 14 seconds after the start of the break. #1 keeps speed around 350 knots diving down the runway to 300 feet over runway. #2/3/4: rejoin before the start of the runway. Halfway a looping is started (90% throttle, reduce throttle at top). Level at 420 knots 500 feet. After a few seconds the #1 breaks left for the overhead break (5 degrees noseup to clear the formation, then left 4G turn while leveling and diving to 600 feet, 200 knots. < 250 knots gear and flaps 1. #2/3/4 will break in 3s intervals. Small turn to the right before going to final to give more room for the turn. Then the turn to final: start with full flaps, follow arc of #1 to runway, reduce speeds slowly to 150 knots and landing at 140 knots. Navy style landing, then #1 and #3 go to left side of the runway, #2 and #4 to right side.

messageEvents.text: 1 AND 3 TO LEFT, 2 AND 4 TO RIGHT

tracks.name: BA5
tracks.description: Full afterburner take-off. Dirty roll on take-off at 130 knots. Turn right low full afterburner. Fly over runway (sneak pass) below mach 1. Turn left hard 90 degrees and rejoin with #2. Go to delta formation and land in overhead break.
